svg.title: Ad Click Event Aggregation — End-to-End Kappa & Reconciliation Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive distributed stream aggregation architecture for 1B daily ad clicks showing Kafka ingestion, cold S3 Parquet archiving, Map-Aggregate-Reduce DAG with event-time watermarks and Top-N min-heaps, exactly-once Kafka sink, ClickHouse real-time OLAP, advertiser query APIs, end-of-day reconciliation, and isolated Kappa recalculation.
svg.text: Ad Click Event Aggregation — End-to-End Kappa & Reconciliation Architecture
1B Clicks/Day (11,574 Avg / 50k Peak QPS) · Map-Aggregate-Reduce DAG · Event-Time Watermarks · Kafka EOS & ClickHouse OLAP
Local Top-N Min-Heap for sliding M-minute window
RocksDB / ForSt Keyed State + Async S3 Checkpoint
Periodic snapshot aligned with Kafka consumer offset
Global-Local merger: sums salted partitions per ad_id
Global Top-N Heap: merges local heaps into final ranking
Replays raw S3 topic · Zero live lag
Two-Stage Salted Routing (Super Bowl Hot Ads)
Problem: Viral ad receives 100x traffic skew, overloading 1 worker.
Stage 1 (Local): Map node appends salt key = ad_id + '_' + rand(S).
S independent Aggregate workers count partial clicks in parallel.
Stage 2 (Global): Strips salt & merges S partial counts into ad_id.
Result: Even CPU load across nodes; zero partition hotspots.
Pre-aggregates by dimensions (country, IP range, user cohort).
filter_id star schema avoids high-cardinality Cartesian explosion.
ClickHouse LowCardinality columns optimize query performance.
Emits window results when W(t) >= window_end (e.g. 12:01:00).
allowedLateness(15m): Re-emits updated sum via ClickHouse UPSERT.
Late events > 15m bypass Flink into Dead-Letter S3 Parquet.
Window Model: Tumbling 1m vs. Sliding M-min
Tumbling: Fixed non-overlapping 1m bins for raw aggregated_count.
Sliding: M-minute window sliding every 1m for popular_ads Top-N.
Local Top-N: Maintains Min-Heap of size N in state per worker.
Heap root stores min count; O(log N) insertion per new ad.
Stream barriers injected into Kafka partitions periodically.
Operators snapshot RocksDB state to S3 asynchronously.
Zero stop-the-world stalls during checkpoint upload.
Recovery: Rewind Kafka offset to last durable checkpoint.
Kafka Source + Flink + Kafka Sink: 2PC Transactional Commit.
Nightly Reconciliation audits raw S3 Parquet logs.
